notes: Chase Avenue / Turrill Street: Chase Avenue's north side is cut by the plate's top edge, so y is a guess (south kerb line about y 75-140; sewer manhole at 10285,20); Turrill's centre is x 10350 (40 ft between about 10290 and 10410). Blue Rock Street is about 175 px wide west of Cherry and east of Turrill, but the block lines stand much further apart between Cherry and Turrill (about 3140-3190 on the north, 3510-3560 on the south); the picks there follow the straight centre line between the narrow parts. McMakin: west of Delaney it is printed 'McMAKIN ST.' (narrow, centre y about 3727 at Delaney); east of Delaney it is 'McMAKIN ALLEY' (12 ft), which is offset at Cherry Street (west arm centre y 3783, east arm 3843), recorded as two T-junctions on each. Cherry / Hoffner: railroad tracks cross the junction; the pick is midway between the offset north and south arms. Colerain / Powers: the street on the west side of Colerain (printed only 'ST.', 40 ft) is taken to be Powers Street continuing; pick is midway between the two arms' meeting points with Colerain's centre line (east arm alone would be about 8985,6998; west arm alone about 8955,6932). Cooper / Colerain is on railroad crossing ground, about 10 px less certain. Turrill does not exist between the railroad (y about 4440) and Hoffner Avenue.
